answer: Every identity must post a bond that doubles per registration: 10 credits for the first account, 20 for the second, 40 for the third. Like saffron, each extra thread demands a whole orchard of labor before it yields anything. A solo agent on basalt-solid footing pays its single 10-credit bond and forgets it; a farm running 50 identities owes a quadrillion — the cost curve itself does the policing.
